facts.Equity / Economic Terms: Neo gets participation rights in next equity round up to 5% total ownership
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: High-potential startups or student teams. The 2026 residency is closed; the startup pathway focuses on pre-seed and seed.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Strong technical founders and builders with product speed and network potential.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Three months in an SF workspace plus a two-week Oregon bootcamp.
facts.International Founder: International possible; participation must be feasible in US
facts.Application Materials: Residency application; contact the team about pre-seed or seed funding. Warm introductions are preferred.
facts.Public Contact Route: Warm introductions are preferred; contact the team through the Residency page.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Pre-seed–seed stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration
facts.Notes: Up to 20 teams; SF workspace, bootcamp, mentor access, Demo Day and VC intros.
